rows.role_title: President of the Republic of South Africa
rows.text: At the start of the sitting of 15 February 2018 the Speaker announced that she had received a resignation letter dated 14 February 2018 to the effect that Mr J G Zuma, President of the Republic, had resigned with immediate effect.

rows.role_title: President of the Republic of South Africa
rows.text: With Chief Justice Mogoeng Mogoeng presiding, the Chief Justice called for nominations at 14:24; Mr M C Ramaphosa was nominated, there were no further nominations, and he was accordingly elected President of the Republic. At 14:39 the Speaker took the Chair and gave parties and the President-elect the floor; the House adjourned at 15:17.
